component.name: VirtConvert
component.summary: Convert Hyper-V disks for VirtualBox and back

description.p: VirtConvert turns Hyper-V disk images (VHD, VHDX) into formats VirtualBox uses (VDI, VMDK), and VirtualBox disks back into VHD or VHDX for Hyper-V and Azure.

ul.li: Hyper-V checkpoints (.avhdx, .avhd) and VirtualBox snapshots are merged with their parents into one disk
Every copy can be compared with its source, byte for byte, before it is saved
Shows whether the disk boots with UEFI or BIOS, and what to set in VirtualBox or Hyper-V
Dynamic or fixed disks, stream-optimized VMDK for OVA appliances, Azure-ready VHD
Converts several images in one go; a command-line interface for scripts
